import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Create the DataFrame
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for transaction types and their amounts
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='transaction_type', y='amount', data=df, ci=None, palette='viridis')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Transaction Amount by Type')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')

# Save the plot as a PNG file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight')
